properties.description: Fixed retained ServiceNow facade only. Fresh execution self-binds managed identity and the fixed authoritative Azure reader. Health checks exact-secret/OAuth/facade access only, not ticket readiness. Case writes require reviewed native provenance and protected commissioning, then freeze immutable intent before create and one initial internal findings note. Original-ID reconciliation governs retries. No repair, closure, feedback, shell or arbitrary HTTP.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Exactly health, read, create, note or reconcile. Before an intent exists, read returns bounded verified native alert/signal context without writes. create delivers the frozen create AND initial note; note retries that note or explicitly appends a verified recurrence update.

parameters.name: investigation_id
parameters.description: Actual native investigation identity. On first read, omit both IDs: the reader independently resolves exactly one fresh matching native incident, rejecting none/ambiguity. Required for writes/reconcile. Never invent an ID or supply an episode UUID.

parameters.name: alert_id
parameters.description: Actual ARM Monitor alert instance ID bound to the investigation. Omit on first read to resolve current structured native status. Required for writes/reconcile; never only a rule ID. Merged recurrence notes retain the original alert_id and use the additional alert as recurrence_id.

parameters.name: evidence_json
parameters.description: For first create or explicit recurrence: complete existing servicenow-case evidence JSON with episode_id OMITTED (derived internally). Reference the actual ARM alert and the selected profile's independently read native telemetry/provider sample. Any referenced guest receipts must be complete and validated. Do not send fragments or secrets. Empty on read/reconcile or frozen-note retry.

parameters.name: findings_note
parameters.description: Initial create or explicit recurrence only: bounded internal findings, at most 3200 characters. Frozen with evidence before POST. Empty on frozen-intent retries.

parameters.name: recurrence_id
parameters.description: note/reconcile only: exact additional authoritative ARM alert instance ID within this owned investigation. Deterministically derives a create-only update intent; never creates another case or initial note. Empty for initial writes.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Exactly disk (default), patch-installation, alert-recurrence, capacity-growth or backup-job, matching the selected native rule. This is a discovery hint, not authorization: protected commissioning, native investigation, exact ARM rule, fixed VM and independent in-window telemetry or terminal provider evidence must all match. Retain the same profile for all operations.
